top1.title: 【2026-11-04】Google、学校でAIを無効にすると検索も利用不可になる方針
top1.lead1: Googleは来年、学校管理者が明示的に有効化しない限り、児童生徒向けAIツールを無効にする方針を示した。
top1.lead2: ただしAIを全面制限するとGoogle検索も利用不可に。学校はAI利用と調べ学習の手段をどう両立するか判断を迫られる。

top10.title: [2026-11-04] Google policy to make Search unavailable at schools that disable AI
top10.summary: Next year, Google will disable AI for schoolchildren unless school administrators explicitly enable it. Schools that fully restrict AI will also lose access to Google Search.

top10.title: [2026-11-04] Anthropic's computing costs rise to 58% of revenue: Analysis of new disclosures
top10.summary: [Analysis] Anthropic's new disclosures show that quarterly revenue grew to $17 billion, while computing costs as a share of revenue rose from 48% to 58%.

top10.title: [2026-11-04] OpenAI claims ChatGPT search volume equals 20% of Google's
top10.summary: OpenAI says ChatGPT's search volume has reached the equivalent of 20% of Google's. However, it has not identified the source of the Google search figures used in the comparison.

top10.title: [2026-11-04] AI inference company Fal raises $1.3 billion at a $16 billion valuation
top10.summary: Fal, which provides inference infrastructure for image, video and audio models, has raised $1.3 billion. Its valuation doubled from $8 billion in April to $16 billion.

top10.title: [2026-11-04] Apple requires 18+ ratings for AI companions involving romance or sexual content
top10.summary: Apple requires an 18+ rating for AI companions and other offerings involving romantic relationships or sexual content. Developers will need to comply with new content descriptors starting November 16.

top10.title: [2026-11-04] Apple Watch adds conversation summaries and transcription of the preceding 15 seconds in developer beta
top10.summary: The watchOS 27.3 developer beta introduces Siri Recap, which summarizes conversations, and Live Rewind, which transcribes the preceding 15 seconds of audio.

top10.title: [2026-11-04] Netflix tests mood-based title discovery with AI Discover in the US
top10.summary: Netflix is introducing AI Discover, which lets users find titles based on their mood, available viewing time and other factors. It is beginning a phased rollout for English-language users on supported TVs in the US.

top10.title: [2026-11-04] Analysis of Apple's AI revenue strategy, centered on device sales and services
top10.summary: [Analysis] The Verge analyzes Apple's AI strategy. In addition to device sales and app commissions, Apple plans to offer purchases of additional usage allowances for its own server-based AI features.

top10.title: [2026-11-04] OpenAI's "compute campus" label draws criticism: Examining power measures and their effectiveness
top10.summary: [Analysis] OpenAI described data centers as "compute campuses" in an announcement about measures to address electricity needs. The Verge reported on measures to address burdens on local communities and on critics' views.

editorsDesk.recTitle: 米国政府、AnthropicにFable 5/Mythos 5の海外アクセス停止命令
editorsDesk.recNote: 輸出規制によりFable 5とMythos 5の全世界・外国アクセスが停止。AI地政学の新局面を象徴する事態。
